title: Check whether a bean exists
summary: Spring Framework: Check whether a bean exists. Check the name missing instead.
introduction: containsBean lets code check a registered name before trying to read it.
learningObjectives: Check whether a bean exists with Spring Framework

blocks.text: Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save each example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. The //DEPS line lets JBang fetch Spring. These examples use the core container and do not start a web server.

blocks.title: Check whether a bean exists

blocks.text: The message bean name was registered from its factory. containsBean therefore reports true.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A name check does not validate every future operation on the bean.

seo.description: Spring Framework: Check whether a bean exists. Check the name missing instead. Follow a small example and practise the idea.
